the_finding: ⛔ A THIRD, MORE SERIOUS DEFECT UNDERNEATH THE TWO THE SEATS WERE LOOKING FOR. Two seats independently caught the canonical-fusion mislabeling and the stale PMID (real, but narrow, prose defects). The arithmetic seat caught something neither expected: §8's ENTIRE evidence base cited research/modalities/atr-hrd-sarcoma-series.json as its producer, but the committed artifact held a completely different GEO series (GSE28866, 99 samples) with NONE of §8's cited numbers (13.33 TPM, GSM9037837, 4423.6 ACTB, etc.) appearing anywhere in it. Root-caused from the committed record, not guessed: commit 4a7030e ('Restore the fan-out map (authorized)') on 2026-08-26 — an unrelated incident restoring a DIFFERENT subsystem's ddG results from git history — swept atr-hrd-sarcoma-series.json, its two input caches, the producing script and its test file into the same restore, adding 5474 lines that turned out to be a stale pre-GSE299349 snapshot (inputs cache fetched_utc 2026-08-07, series GSE28866) even though the SCRIPT's own SERIES constant still correctly reads 'GSE299349'. `--check` passed the whole time because it only verifies the artifact reproduces from ITS OWN cache — never that the cache is for the series a citing manuscript names. This is the exact CLAUDE.md §4 shape: an instrument reporting a false absence of a problem (green --check) while the thing it exists to verify was silently wrong.
